items.title: McCae Hillstead Named America First Credit Union Utah State Student-Athlete of the Week
items.summary: LOGAN, Utah – Utah State football junior quarterback McCae Hillstead has been named the America First Credit Union USU Student-Athlete of the Week for the period ending on Sunday, Nov. 1. The award is voted on by a state-wide media panel.

items.title: Aggie Football Drops 20-17 Heartbreaker at Texas State
items.summary: SAN MARCOS, Texas – Utah State football battled to the final seconds but came up short in a 20-17 loss at Texas State on Saturday night at UFCU Stadium.

items.title: Eli Wood Added to Biletnikoff Award Watch List
items.summary: LOGAN, Utah – Utah State receiver Eli Wood has been added the Biletnikoff Award Watch List it was announced Wednesday by The Tallahassee Quarterback Club Foundation.

items.title: Asher Cunningham Named Walter Camp Foundation National Defensive Player of the Week
items.summary: LOGAN, Utah – Utah State inside linebacker Asher Cunningham was named the Walter Camp Foundation National Defensive Player of the Week on Tuesday following his performance in USU's 17-16 home win against Washington State on Friday night.

items.title: Utah State’s Asher Cunningham Named Pac-12 Defensive Player of the Week
items.summary: LOGAN, Utah – Utah State inside linebacker Asher Cunningham was named the Pac-12 Defensive Player of the Week for his performance in USU's 17-16 home win against Washington State on Friday night.

items.title: Aggies Pull Off Second-Half Comeback for 17-16 Win Over Washington State
items.summary: LOGAN, Utah – After falling behind in the first half, Utah State football rallied in all three phases of the game to complete a 13-point second-half comeback to defeat Washington State 17-16 on Friday night at Maverik Stadium.
